# Feature sets

```{r}
feat_base_experiment <- c("treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "hgnc_symbol")
feat_mouse  <- c("mean_log2fc_mouse", "abs_rank_log2fc_mouse")
feat_noise  <- c("inverse_se_mouse")
feat_seq    <- c("dist_k80", "identity_human2mouse")
feat_tfs    <- c("n_tf_total", "pct_tf_shared")
feat_cre    <- c(
  "n_total_cres_gene",
  "n_type_PLS",  "pct_match_type_PLS",  "pct_match_ctcf_PLS_CTCF-bound",
  "n_type_pELS", "pct_match_type_pELS", "pct_match_ctcf_pELS_CTCF-bound",
  "n_type_dELS", "pct_match_type_dELS", "pct_match_ctcf_dELS_CTCF-bound"
)
feat_btms <- c(
  "Not-BTM", "INNATE RESPONSE", "B CELLS", "T CELLS", "PLATELETS",
  "ECM AND MIGRATION", "ENERGY METABOLISM", "MONOCYTES", "CELL CYCLE",
  "IFN", "SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION", "NK CELLS", "NEUTROPHILS"
)
layers <- c(feat_seq, feat_tfs, feat_cre, feat_btms)

feat_mouse       <- c("mean_log2fc_mouse", "abs_rank_log2fc_mouse")   # all-gene rank (regression)
feat_mouse_class <- c("mean_log2fc_mouse", "rank_mouse_btm")          # BTM-only rank (classification)

# Task 2 (classification, BTM scope): uses BTM-only rank
sets_A  <- list("DGE Baseline" = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, feat_mouse_class),
                "Full + BTM"   = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, feat_mouse_class, layers))
sets_B  <- list("DGE Baseline" = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise),
                "Full + BTM"   = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, layers))
# Task 1 (convergence): rank_diff controlling for dual_rank
sets1_A <- list("DGE Baseline" = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, feat_mouse, "dual_rank"),
                "Full + BTM"   = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, feat_mouse, "dual_rank", layers))
sets1_B <- list("DGE Baseline" = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, "dual_rank"),
                "Full + BTM"   = c(feat_base_experiment, feat_noise, "dual_rank", layers))
sets_3a <- list("Mouse only"     = c(feat_base_experiment, "abs_rank_log2fc_mouse"),
                "Mouse + layers" = c(feat_base_experiment, "abs_rank_log2fc_mouse", layers))
sets_3b <- list("Direction only"     = c(feat_base_experiment, "sign_mouse"),
                "Direction + layers" = c(feat_base_experiment, "sign_mouse", layers))
```

# Build modelling table + targets

```{r}
df_all <- dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered %>%
  inner_join(gene_annotated_layers, by = "hgnc_symbol") %>%
  filter(treatment %in% treatments_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_mouse    = abs_rank_log2fc_mouse,      # all-gene rank (regression)
    rank_human    = abs_rank_log2fc_human,      # all-gene rank (regression)
    rank_diff     = abs(rank_mouse - rank_human),
    dual_rank     = pmin(rank_mouse, rank_human),
    conv_rel      = dual_rank * (1 - rank_diff / 100),
    sign_mouse    = sign(mean_log2fc_mouse),
    sign_human    = sign(mean_log2fc_human),
    sign_concordant = factor(sign_mouse == sign_human, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))
  )

# BTM-only ranks (classification scope): rank among all BTM genes per condition
btm_gene_set <- df_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(process), process != "Not-BTM") %>%
  distinct(hgnc_symbol) %>% pull(hgnc_symbol)

btm_ranks <- df_all %>%
  filter(hgnc_symbol %in% btm_gene_set) %>%
  distinct(treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol,
           mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human, p_adj_mouse, p_adj_human) %>%
  group_by(treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_mouse_btm = percent_rank(abs(mean_log2fc_mouse) * -log10(pmax(p_adj_mouse, 1e-300))) * 100,
    rank_human_btm = percent_rank(abs(mean_log2fc_human) * -log10(pmax(p_adj_human, 1e-300))) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, hgnc_symbol, rank_mouse_btm, rank_human_btm)

df_all <- df_all %>% left_join(btm_ranks, by = c("treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "hgnc_symbol"))

cat("df_all rows:", nrow(df_all), " | BTM genes:", length(btm_gene_set), "\n")
table(df_all$pathogen)
```

# Helpers

```{r}
min_max <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  rng <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(rng) || rng == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / rng
}

# generic LOCO regression
loco_regression <- function(df, selection, target, set_name, framing) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(selection), all_of(target)) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(target)) %>% distinct()

  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, "~ .")), data = d) %>%
    update_role(any_of(c("hgnc_symbol", "treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison")), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  wf_lm <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec) %>% add_model(linear_reg() %>% set_engine("lm"))
  wf_rf <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(rand_forest(trees = 500, mtry = 8, min_n = 5) %>%
                set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity", num.threads = 8) %>%
                set_mode("regression"))

  fit_lm <- fit(wf_lm, data = d); fit_rf <- fit(wf_rf, data = d)

  coefs <- tidy(extract_fit_engine(fit_lm), conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
    mutate(feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", "")) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name, framing = framing)

  rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(fit_rf)
  imp <- tibble(feature_name_original = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
                importance = as.numeric(rf_engine$variable.importance)) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name, framing = framing)

  set.seed(seed); folds <- group_vfold_cv(d, group = pathogen, v = 4)
  cv_lm <- fit_resamples(wf_lm, resamples = folds)
  cv_rf <- fit_resamples(wf_rf, resamples = folds)
  cv_metrics <- function(cv, model_name) {
    m <- collect_metrics(cv)
    tibble(model = model_name,
           rmse = m$mean[m$.metric == "rmse"],
           rsq  = m$mean[m$.metric == "rsq"])
  }
  metrics <- bind_rows(cv_metrics(cv_lm, "Linear (LM)"), cv_metrics(cv_rf, "Random Forest")) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name, framing = framing, target = target, task = "regression")

  list(metrics = metrics, coefficients = coefs, importance = imp, fit_lm = fit_lm, fit_rf = fit_rf)
}

# generic LOCO classification
loco_classification <- function(df, selection, target, set_name, framing) {
  d <- df %>% select(all_of(selection), all_of(target)) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(target)) %>%
    mutate(!!target := factor(.data[[target]], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))

  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, "~ .")), data = d) %>%
    update_role(any_of(c("hgnc_symbol", "treatment", "pathogen", "timepoint_comparison")), new_role = "id") %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.9) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  wf_log <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec) %>% add_model(logistic_reg() %>% set_engine("glm"))
  wf_rf <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(rand_forest(trees = 500, mtry = 8, min_n = 5) %>%
                set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity", num.threads = 8) %>%
                set_mode("classification"))

  fit_log <- fit(wf_log, data = d); fit_rf <- fit(wf_rf, data = d)

  coefs <- tidy(extract_fit_engine(fit_log), conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    rename(feature_name_original = term) %>%
    mutate(feature_name_original = str_replace_all(feature_name_original, "`", "")) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name, framing = framing)

  rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(fit_rf)
  imp <- tibble(feature_name_original = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
                importance = as.numeric(rf_engine$variable.importance)) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name, framing = framing)

  set.seed(seed); folds <- group_vfold_cv(d, group = pathogen, v = 4)
  cv_log <- fit_resamples(wf_log, resamples = folds, control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE))
  cv_rf  <- fit_resamples(wf_rf,  resamples = folds, control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE))
  cv_metrics <- function(cv, model_name) {
    p <- collect_predictions(cv)
    tibble(model = model_name,
           roc_auc = roc_auc(p, truth = !!sym(target), .pred_TRUE, event_level = "second")$.estimate,
           pr_auc  = pr_auc(p,  truth = !!sym(target), .pred_TRUE, event_level = "second")$.estimate)
  }
  metrics <- bind_rows(cv_metrics(cv_log, "Logistic Regression"), cv_metrics(cv_rf, "Random Forest")) %>%
    mutate(feature_set = set_name, framing = framing, target = target, task = "classification")

  list(metrics = metrics, coefficients = coefs, importance = imp, fit_log = fit_log, fit_rf = fit_rf)
}
```

```{r}

res1_B <- imap(sets1_B, ~ loco_regression(df_all, .x, "rank_diff", .y, "B_explanatory"))

metrics_task1 <- bind_rows(map_dfr(res1_A, "metrics"), map_dfr(res1_B, "metrics"))

imp_task1     <- bind_rows(map_dfr(res1_A, "importance"),   map_dfr(res1_B, "importance"))
```

# SCORES — score_shared (original weights, name-fixed) + score_conv (Task 1 Model A Full)

```{r}
select_model_shared <- "+ Sequence + TFs + CRE type + CTCF"

wv_class <- rf_importance_class %>%
  filter(feature_set == select_model_shared) %>%
  select(feature_name, importance, feature_set) %>%
  inner_join(logit_coefs, by = join_by(feature_set, feature_name)) %>%
  mutate(raw_weight = sign(estimate) * importance,
         norm_weight = raw_weight / max(abs(raw_weight), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(feature_name, norm_weight) %>% deframe()

# score_conv weights from Task 1, Model A, Full + BTM
lm_conv  <- res1_A[["Full + BTM"]]$coefficients
imp_conv <- res1_A[["Full + BTM"]]$importance
wv_conv <- imp_conv %>%
  select(feature_name_original, importance) %>%
  inner_join(lm_conv, by = "feature_name_original") %>%
  left_join(feature_dictionary, by = "feature_name_original") %>%
  mutate(raw_weight = sign(estimate) * importance,
         norm_weight = raw_weight / max(abs(raw_weight), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(feature_name, norm_weight) %>%
  filter(!is.na(feature_name), !duplicated(feature_name)) %>%
  deframe()

get_w <- function(vec, name) { w <- unname(vec[name]); if (is.null(w) || is.na(w)) 0 else w }
```

```{r}
score_tbl <- df_all %>%
  group_by(treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    f_fc        = min_max(abs(mean_log2fc_mouse)),
    f_rank      = min_max(abs(abs_rank_log2fc_mouse)),
    f_dual      = min_max(dual_rank),
    f_inv_se    = min_max(log1p(inverse_se_mouse)),
    f_kimura    = min_max(dist_k80),
    f_aa_id     = min_max(identity_human2mouse),
    f_tf_total  = min_max(n_tf_total),
    f_tf_shared = min_max(pct_tf_shared),
    f_dels_ncres = min_max(n_type_dELS),
    f_dels_match = min_max(`pct_match_type_dELS`),
    f_dels_ctcf  = min_max(`pct_match_ctcf_dELS_CTCF-bound`),
    f_pels_ncres = min_max(n_type_pELS),
    f_pels_match = min_max(`pct_match_type_pELS`),
    f_pels_ctcf  = min_max(`pct_match_ctcf_pELS_CTCF-bound`),
    f_pls_ncres  = min_max(n_type_PLS),
    f_pls_match  = min_max(`pct_match_type_PLS`),
    f_pls_ctcf   = min_max(`pct_match_ctcf_PLS_CTCF-bound`),

    raw_class =
      f_fc * get_w(wv_class, "Log2FC (Mouse)") +
      f_rank * get_w(wv_class, "|Rank (Mouse)|") +
      f_inv_se * get_w(wv_class, "1/SE") +
      f_kimura * get_w(wv_class, "Kimura distance") +
      f_aa_id * get_w(wv_class, "%Protein AA identity") +
      f_tf_total * get_w(wv_class, "nTotal TFs") +
      f_tf_shared * get_w(wv_class, "%Shared TFs") +
      f_dels_ncres * get_w(wv_class, "dELS nCREs") +
      f_dels_match * get_w(wv_class, "dELS %Match Type") +
      f_dels_ctcf * get_w(wv_class, "dELS CTCF %Match CTCF") +
      f_pels_ncres * get_w(wv_class, "pELS nCREs") +
      f_pels_match * get_w(wv_class, "pELS %Match Type") +
      f_pels_ctcf * get_w(wv_class, "pELS CTCF %Match CTCF") +
      f_pls_ncres * get_w(wv_class, "PLS nCREs") +
      f_pls_match * get_w(wv_class, "PLS %Match Type") +
      f_pls_ctcf * get_w(wv_class, "PLS CTCF %Match CTCF"),

    raw_conv =
      f_fc * get_w(wv_conv, "Log2FC (Mouse)") +
      f_rank * get_w(wv_conv, "|Rank (Mouse)|") +
      f_dual * get_w(wv_conv, "Dual rank") +
      f_inv_se * get_w(wv_conv, "1/SE") +
      f_kimura * get_w(wv_conv, "Kimura distance") +
      f_aa_id * get_w(wv_conv, "%Protein AA identity") +
      f_tf_total * get_w(wv_conv, "nTotal TFs") +
      f_tf_shared * get_w(wv_conv, "%Shared TFs") +
      f_dels_ncres * get_w(wv_conv, "dELS nCREs") +
      f_dels_match * get_w(wv_conv, "dELS %Match Type") +
      f_dels_ctcf * get_w(wv_conv, "dELS CTCF %Match CTCF") +
      f_pels_ncres * get_w(wv_conv, "pELS nCREs") +
      f_pels_match * get_w(wv_conv, "pELS %Match Type") +
      f_pels_ctcf * get_w(wv_conv, "pELS CTCF %Match CTCF") +
      f_pls_ncres * get_w(wv_conv, "PLS nCREs") +
      f_pls_match * get_w(wv_conv, "PLS %Match Type") +
      f_pls_ctcf * get_w(wv_conv, "PLS CTCF %Match CTCF"),

    score_shared = min_max(raw_class) * 100,
    score_conv   = (1 - min_max(raw_conv)) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with("f_"), -raw_class, -raw_conv) %>%
  ungroup()

score_plot <- score_tbl %>%
  bind_rows(score_tbl %>% mutate(treatment = "Pooled", pathogen = "", timepoint_comparison = ""))

saveRDS(score_plot, here("tests", "v2", "Models", "score_table_v2.rds"))
```

# Priority list (strict) + annotations

```{r}
pooled <- score_plot %>% filter(treatment == "Pooled")

priority_list <- pooled %>%
  filter(dual_rank >= 75, rank_diff <= 25, p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>%
  distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(conv_rel)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  select(hgnc_symbol, process, rank_mouse, rank_human, rank_diff, dual_rank, conv_rel,
         mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human, sign_mouse, sign_human, sign_concordant,
         score_shared, score_conv, status_original, p_adj_mouse)

priority_list
write_csv(priority_list, here("tests", "v2", "Tables", "priority_relevant_convergent_top20.csv"))

# quick correlation diagnostics (with BH padj)
diag_stats <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
  tibble(rho = cor(x, y, method = "spearman"),
         r   = cor(x, y, method = "pearson"),
         r2  = summary(lm(y ~ x))$r.squared,
         p_spearman = cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
         p_pearson  = cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson")$p.value)
}
bind_rows(
  diag_stats(pooled$score_conv, pooled$rank_diff) %>% mutate(comparison = "score_conv vs rank_diff"),
  diag_stats(pooled$score_conv, pooled$dual_rank) %>% mutate(comparison = "score_conv vs dual_rank"),
  diag_stats(pooled$score_conv, pooled$abs_log2fc_diff) %>% mutate(comparison = "score_conv vs |dLog2FC|"),
  diag_stats(pooled$rank_mouse, pooled$rank_human) %>% mutate(comparison = "rank_mouse vs rank_human")
) %>% mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_spearman, method = "BH"))
```

# Figures (project style)

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# correlation label helper (rho + R2 + padj), overall
cor_label <- function(df, x, y) {
  tibble(
    rho = cor(df[[x]], df[[y]], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    r2  = summary(lm(df[[y]] ~ df[[x]]))$r.squared,
    p   = cor.test(df[[x]], df[[y]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value
  ) %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
           label = sprintf("rho=%.2f\nR2=%.2f\npadj=%.1e", rho, r2, padj))
}

# 1) score_shared vs rank_mouse (pooled)
p1 <- pooled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score_shared, y = rank_mouse, fill = status_original)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.2, stroke = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$comparison) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(x = "score_shared", y = "Rank (Mouse)", fill = "LEG status",
       title = "Shared LEG score vs mouse rank (pooled)")

# 2) score_conv vs |dLog2FC| -- colour by score
lab2 <- cor_label(pooled, "score_conv", "abs_log2fc_diff")
p2 <- pooled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score_conv, y = abs_log2fc_diff, fill = score_conv)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#4cc9f0", "#4361ee")) +
  geom_text(data = lab2, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(x = "score_conv", y = "|ΔLog2FC|", fill = "Score", title = "Convergence score vs divergence")

# 3) 1/SE vs |dLog2FC| -- colour by score
lab3 <- cor_label(pooled, "inverse_se_mouse", "abs_log2fc_diff")
p3 <- pooled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = inverse_se_mouse, y = abs_log2fc_diff, fill = score_conv)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#4cc9f0", "#4361ee")) +
  geom_text(data = lab3, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(x = "1/SE (mouse)", y = "|ΔLog2FC|", fill = "Score", title = "Precision vs divergence")

# 4) score_conv vs rank_mouse
lab4 <- cor_label(pooled, "score_conv", "rank_mouse")
p4 <- pooled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = score_conv, y = rank_mouse, fill = score_conv)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#4cc9f0", "#4361ee")) +
  geom_text(data = lab4, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(x = "score_conv", y = "Rank (Mouse)", fill = "Score", title = "Convergence score vs relevance")

# 5) rank_mouse vs |dLog2FC| -- colour by score, highlight high score
lab5 <- cor_label(pooled, "rank_mouse", "abs_log2fc_diff")
p5 <- pooled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank_mouse, y = abs_log2fc_diff, fill = score_conv)) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(score_conv < 90), shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.2, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(score_conv >= 90), shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 1, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#4cc9f0", "#4361ee")) +
  geom_text(data = lab5, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(x = "Rank (Mouse)", y = "|ΔLog2FC|", fill = "Score", title = "Relevance vs divergence")

# 6) rank_mouse vs rank_human -- colour by score, highlight high score
lab6 <- cor_label(pooled, "rank_mouse", "rank_human")
p6 <- pooled %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank_mouse, y = rank_human, fill = score_conv)) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(score_conv < 90), shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 0.2, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = . %>% filter(score_conv >= 90), shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 1, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white", "#4cc9f0", "#4361ee")) +
  geom_text(data = lab6, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(x = "Rank (Mouse)", y = "Rank (Human)", fill = "Score", title = "Dual-species rank (pooled)")
```
